newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends slightly firmer vs dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends slightly firmer vs dollar.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed slightly firmer at 43.7490/7500 to the dollar in a dull interbank session on Saturday against its previous close at 43.7495/7500, dealers said.
The local unit was quoted weaker and in a wider range in early trade but edged up later with a rise in call money rates.
"There were very few transactions. Banks are holding back the greenback because of the central bank's tightening of dollar selling," said one dealer.
The call money was traded at 11 to 14 percent, up from Thursday's eight to 8.5 percent, following Wednesday's auction of central bank bills worth more than 2.7 billion taka.
